title: Blood Donation App
summary: Find blood donors by blood type and request a donation. I designed it in Figma, built it natively in Kotlin with Firebase, then rebuilt it in Flutter.

caseStudy.overview: A mobile app where users find donors of a specific blood type and send donation requests.
caseStudy.problem: When a patient needs a specific blood type, finding a willing donor quickly usually means a lot of phone calls.
contribution: Built the first version in Kotlin with Firebase in Android Studio.
Rebuilt it in Flutter with Riverpod for state, go_router for navigation and Hive for local storage.

decisions.title: Rebuild in Flutter
decisions.body: The original native Kotlin app was rebuilt in Flutter, moving the product onto the cross-platform stack used across later projects.
